versions.subject: Detect Sudo enumeration commands
versions.detection:
keywords:
    - 'sudo -l'
    - 'sudo su'
    - 'cat /etc/sudoers'
    - 'vim /etc/sudoers'
condition: keywords
versions.spl: "sudo -l" OR "sudo su" OR "cat /etc/sudoers" OR "vim /etc/sudoers"

versions.subject: Update lnx_setuid_setgid.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    - 'sudo chown root *'    
selection2:
    - 'sudo chmod u+s *'
selection3:
    - 'sudo chmod g+s *'
condition: (selection1 and selection2) or (selection1 and selection3)
versions.spl: ("sudo chown root *" "sudo chmod u+s *") OR ("sudo chown root *" "sudo chmod g+s *")

    CommandLine|contains: 'chown root'
selection_perm:

        - ' chmod u+s'
        - ' chmod g+s'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: CommandLine="*chown root*" CommandLine IN ("* chmod u+s*", "* chmod g+s*")
